Subject: twistor theory | ID: 72098

Step 3. Using the diagonalizable regularization, we obtain \(B_{01270013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Harnack space.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via variational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
